title: Immunovant ditches lupus for multi-hyphenate inflammatory drug after mid-stage miss
snippet: After imeroprubart failed to demonstrate sufficient efficacy in lupus during a Phase 2b trial, Immunovant is moving on from the indication and looking to other high priority programs for the drug in neurology, endocrinology and rheumatology.

title: AI drug hunter Enveda raises $311M for late-stage obesity, inflammatory disease push
snippet: Tech darling Enveda has raised a total of $845 million in the past six years. The latest funding round is intended to pave the way for an IPO someday.

title: Amgen asset from $27.8B Horizon buy scores in Phase 3 Sjögren's study
snippet: Amgen is awaiting another Phase 3 readout for the investigational Sjögren's disease therapy, set for later this year. William Blair anticipates that at least two trials will be needed to support an FDA application.

title: Roche-Ionis’ RNA therapy reduces kidney disease marker, opening path to swift FDA nod
snippet: A late-stage test of Roche and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ sefaxersen showed that the drug reduced protein in the urine, which suggests the RNA-targeting therapy could improve kidney function and delay transplant.

title: Novartis bets up to $900M for radioligand therapy from China’s BoomRay
snippet: Novartis is the current radiopharma leader with two FDA-approved therapies in Pluvicto and Lutathera.

title: Pharmas face off for manufacturing talent amidst reshoring efforts
snippet: As pharmas reshore manufacturing, they’re squaring off with each other to find the right personnel to staff up their plants. That task is challenging given the limited talent pool, difficulty filling critical roles and, in some cases, competition from data centers.
